items.headline: Heather Dinich picks how many SEC teams make the CFP field
items.description: ESPN's Dinich joins SEC Now ahead of Week 11 to preview some of the most consequential matchups and discuss the path to the CFP for Kentucky, Ole Miss and LSU.

items.headline: Analyzing where LSU must improve in red zone against Texas
items.description: SEC Network's Benjamin Watson takes a look at the No. 21 Tigers' performance in the red zone as he discusses where they must get better if they want to beat the No. 6 Longhorns.

items.headline: Holly Rowe previews No. 6 Texas vs. No. 21 LSU
items.description: With the Longhorns set to play the Tigers in Baton Rouge for the first time since 1953, ESPN's Rowe joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss the matchup and how the Tigers can regroup.

items.headline: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
items.description: Travel plans for teams in multiple sports were disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.
